description: This header file declares structures, constants, and function prototypes related to 'tree' objects, likely representing directory-like structures or commit trees in a version control system. It includes functions for parsing, comparing, and reading tree objects, as well as external references to other core objects such as repository and object identifiers.

methods.name: lookup_tree
methods.description: Locate a tree object within a repository using an object ID.

methods.name: parse_tree_buffer
methods.description: Parse a raw buffer into a tree structure.

methods.name: parse_tree_gently
methods.description: Parse a tree structure, optionally suppressing errors for missing data.

methods.name: free_tree_buffer
methods.description: Free resources associated with a tree's buffer.

methods.name: parse_tree_indirect
methods.description: Retrieve and parse a tree object indirectly through its object ID.

methods.name: base_name_compare
methods.description: Compare base names of paths with mode context for sorting or matching.

methods.name: df_name_compare
methods.description: Compare directory file names with mode context, possibly for directory comparison.

methods.name: name_compare
methods.description: Compare two path names with specified lengths.

methods.name: read_tree_at
methods.description: Read and process a subtree at a specified depth and path within a repository.

methods.name: read_tree
methods.description: Read the entire tree object from a repository, possibly filtered by pathspec.

ctags.name: read_tree_fn_t
ctags.pattern: /^typedef int (*read_tree_fn_t)(const struct object_id *, struct strbuf *, const char *, unsigned /
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(const struct object_id *,struct strbuf *,const char *,unsigned int,void *)
